blocks.html: Each habitable room shall have at least 1 window with 6 square feet (.55 m 2 ) of openable area to provide natural ventilation as required pursuant to Section 1203.5.1.2.1. The total net glazed area of all windows shall be not less than 10 percent of the floor area of the room served, or 12 square feet (1.1 m 2 ), whichever is greater. Such area may include glazed areas in doors providing light directly into such room.
